_comment: Speeds and attack_range are final world units, already multiplied by IsoVolume.WORLD_SCALE (1.2708197158225134). Do not scale them again. attack_speed is attacks per second. hp, defense, and attack are points. Only the generic villager is spawned today. Spearman and engineer are the agreed knight and robot roles for a later recruit pass. Contact still infects a villager in one touch; their attack stats are not spent yet.

units.notes: Cosmetic pool for the auto villagers. move_speed is the old 108 * WORLD_SCALE. Wander still uses 0.72x of it and panic 1.15x, in villager.gd.
Knight sheet (villager_3). move_speed and attack_range are 90 and 48 times WORLD_SCALE. Not spawned until recruitment is wired.
Robot sheet (villager_5). Faster repair comes later. move_speed and attack_range are 100 and 42 times WORLD_SCALE.
